sam: Quick PSA — ran into an annoying bundler + edge runtime problem with the JS SDK when apps use `import default` from ESM consumers. Repro is tiny.

priya: what's the symptom?

sam: runtime flakiness on token refresh (401s) and TS complaining about missing call signatures. Happens only after building for edge (SSR/build output), not in dev server.

miguel: which bundlers? can you repro with webpack/rollup/vite?

sam: yes, short matrix: 
- Vite (build -> ssr): fails when SDK gets rolled into cjs-shaped chunk (default import becomes wrapper)
- Rollup (app bundle): fails if commonjs plugin doesn't convert our dist CJS correctly
- Webpack: fails on older configs that treat node_modules as CJS fallback

Repro steps (minimal):
1) create a fresh app (e.g., vite react-ts or rollup sample)
2) npm i ../local-sdk-build or npm i @redwood/inference-js@local
3) in app src: `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference-js'`
4) build for SSR/edge and call client.request -> observe 401 loop + logs from sdk: `AuthError: token missing` then `RetryAttempt: token fetch returned undefined`

Example CF worker log excerpt:
```
[edge] AuthError: token missing
    at fetchToken (/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.cjs:32:14)
    at request (/node_modules/@redwood/inference-js/dist/index.cjs:98:10)
Retrying request (1)
[edge] AuthError: token fetch returned undefined
```

priya: sounds like interop wrapper yields an object with `.default` and code expects a function. Any quick workarounds?

sam: workarounds we validated locally: 
- Prefer named imports: `import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'` (the cleanest)
- Vite: in vite.config.ts add `ssr: { noExternal: ['@redwood/inference-js'] }` so esbuild preserves ESM export shape; or `optimizeDeps.include: ['@redwood/inference-js']` so dev server mirrors runtime
- Rollup: ensure `@rollup/plugin-commonjs` handles node_modules, or add `external: []` entries so rollup keeps ESM files intact
- Webpack: mark the package as an ESM module or enable `.mjs` handling in rules
- TS: as a last resort, set `esModuleInterop: true` + `allowSyntheticDefaultImports: true` in tsconfig to suppress type errors

miguel: any package-side fixes we can ship?

sam: proposals: 
1) publish an explicit ESM entry (index.mjs) that re-exports only named symbols (no default) — this removes ambiguous default interop wrappers
2) adjust package.json `exports` map with conditional exports: { "import": "dist/index.mjs", "require": "dist/index.cjs" } so bundlers resolve correctly
3) include a tiny `pkg-module` file that is pure ESM and includes `export { RedwoodClient } from './dist/index.js'` (no `export default`)

priya: good. Also we should add one-line docs for onboarding: "If you see auth retries/401s after build: switch to named import or add ssr.noExternal for vite." Put that in the SDK migration/known-issues page.

build-bot: CI flaky: sample-app-edge (#202) failing intermittently in auth-integration test — queued for rerun.

miguel: can you capture a minimal repro repo (or a gist) with both vite and rollup variants? I'll add tests to our CI matrix to cover `vite build` + `rollup build` + `webpack prod` combos.

sam: will push 2 gists (vite-edge-shim and rollup-edge-shim) with exact configs and a tiny server script to show log output. Quick local commands I used:
```
git clone https://gist.github.com/xxxx/vite-edge-shim.git
cd vite-edge-shim
npm i
npm run build:ssr
NODE_ENV=production node ./dist/server.js
# call http://localhost:3000/api/test -> watch logs
```

priya: I'll draft the onboarding note and add a short troubleshooting checklist: default vs named import, vite ssr.noExternal, tsconfig shim, package exports change.
